versions.content: Name Dem_DebounceResetStatusType Kind Type Derived from uint8 DEM_DEBOUNCE_STATUS_ FREEZE 0x00 Freeze the internal debounce counter/timer. DEM_DEBOUNCE_STATUS_ RESET 0x01 Reset the internal debounce counter/timer. Range 0x02 - 0xFF reserved Description This type contains all definitions to control an internal debounce counter/timer via the function Dem_ResetEventDebounceStatus(). Variation – Available via Rte_Dem_Type.h
